sessions.title: Opening Keynote
sessions.reason: Frame GEICO's software-delivery investment priorities around GitHub's direction and new announcements. Separate announced capabilities from longer-term possibilities before taking decisions back to the leadership team.

sessions.title: Agentic engineering past the pilot: An enterprise playbook
sessions.reason: Consider how enterprise governance, developer experience, and adoption fit into one operating model. Focus on decision rights and organizational patterns for moving agentic delivery beyond isolated pilots.

sessions.title: Building AI fluency at UPS
sessions.reason: Use UPS's enterprise experience to distinguish trial usage from genuine AI fluency. Examine the leadership role in motivation, measurement, and removing the next bottlenecks across software delivery.

sessions.title: The Low Orbit Agentic Cannon: Scaling Copilot through internal tooling
sessions.reason: Galaxy's scaling experience offers an alternative view of the investment, operating discipline, and organizational leverage behind internal agent tooling.
sessions.note: Choose instead of the 11:30 AM UPS session; arrive about 20 minutes early. Then rejoin at 12:50 PM.

sessions.title: The factory mindset: Agentic workflows in production
sessions.reason: Compare governed production adoption across GitHub, retail, and regulated healthcare. Evaluate centralized controls, auditability, and the operating changes required to scale agent workflows responsibly.

sessions.title: What does shift left mean in an agentic world?
sessions.reason: Examine the evidence and human oversight needed before agents change production systems. Use this focused demo to sharpen executive questions about accountability, reviewability, and operational risk.

sessions.title: Beyond "hours saved": How AMD and ING measure AI at enterprise scale
sessions.reason: Compare AMD and ING's approaches to connecting AI investment with engineering and business outcomes. Identify measures that can inform rollout decisions without treating usage counts as proof of value.

sessions.title: One PM, four weeks, full compliance: How itti shipped a banking product with agents
sessions.reason: Compare banking-product delivery speed with human approval gates and traceability. Useful if regulated-business governance is a higher priority than AI investment measurement.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor
sessions.note: Replaces the Wednesday 2:30 PM AMD/ING session. Rejoin at 3:30 PM; allow a tight 20-minute transfer.

sessions.title: Stop guessing: What 37 million pull requests reveal about AI impact
sessions.reason: Use Jellyfish's cross-company pull-request research to challenge broad adoption claims and identify meaningful delivery signals. Treat the findings as peer evidence, not a prediction of GEICO's results.
sessions.note: Tight transfer: 20 minutes from the prior session, including an estimated 15-minute walk and five-minute early arrival. Allow extra time for queues.

sessions.title: PATs, rulesets, and IP allowlists: How Confluent secured GitHub Enterprise Cloud
sessions.reason: Use Confluent's experience to examine the tradeoffs and organizational effort behind enterprise security controls. Focus on policy rollout, ownership, and which controls justify the investment.
sessions.note: Replaces the Wednesday 3:30 PM measurement session. The 4:30 PM session then has a tight 20-minute transfer.

sessions.title: The human side of AI: How building community drove 94% Copilot adoption
sessions.reason: Explore how a financial-services organization built trust and adoption through community, storytelling, and shared practice. Translate the lessons into leadership sponsorship and a sustainable enablement approach.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor

sessions.title: The view from the labs: What's next for AI-assisted development
sessions.reason: Hear model-lab leaders discuss the next two years of AI-assisted development. Use the outlook to pressure-test investment assumptions, workforce priorities, and the durability of today's operating choices.

sessions.title: Visa's Zero-Secrets Initiative: no hardcoded secrets, no exceptions
sessions.reason: Evaluate Visa's policy ownership, credential-risk reduction, and prevention practices as a large-enterprise governance case. Consider the operating discipline needed to turn a policy into sustained behavior.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor
sessions.note: Replaces Thursday's 9:00 AM model-lab panel. Stay in the same building for Vanguard at 10:00 AM.

sessions.title: From AI-assisted work to agent-enabled delivery: Scaling AI across product teams
sessions.reason: Study Vanguard's structured maturity framework across cross-functional product teams. Focus on milestones, sequencing, and leadership accountability when progressing from AI assistance to agent-enabled delivery.
sessions.room: BATS Theatre @ Fort Mason Building B, 3rd Floor

sessions.title: AI, Actions, and tooling: Coinbase's move to GitHub with data residency
sessions.reason: Consider Coinbase's approach to maintaining developer productivity through a regulated platform migration. Take away questions about sponsorship, compliance, self-service, and change risk rather than an implementation checklist.
sessions.note: Tight transfer: 20 minutes from the prior session, including an estimated 15-minute walk and five-minute early arrival. Allow extra time for queues.

sessions.title: 17 agents, one SDLC: How Levi Strauss reimagined development on GitHub
sessions.reason: Evaluate how Levi Strauss distributes work across agents while retaining human approval gates. Focus on decision rights, organizational readiness, and how to extend automation across the software lifecycle.

sessions.title: People, process, and GitHub: Eliminating 90% of enterprise AppSec risk
sessions.reason: Manulife offers a direct insurer perspective on security culture, risk visibility, and accountable remediation. Focus on leadership practices rather than assuming another organization's numeric results will transfer.
sessions.note: Choose instead of the 12:15 PM Levi Strauss session and skip 1:05 PM to avoid a rushed transfer. Arrive about 20 minutes early; rejoin at 2:00 PM.

sessions.title: Why sketching in code matters more in the age of AI
sessions.reason: Explore why creative judgment and understanding remain important as AI generates more output. Apply the discussion to workforce development, cross-functional leadership, and preserving human accountability for decisions.

sessions.title: Closing Keynote
sessions.reason: Close with open-source perspectives and demonstrations, then distill the most useful lessons into executive follow-up priorities. The detailed keynote program is still developing; no particular announcement is assumed.
